summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Iron Mountain Inc reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on May 7, 2026. The filing discloses the election of eleven directors, approval of a non-binding advisory resolution on executive compensation, and ratification of Deloitte as independent auditor. It also details committee appointments post-meeting. No special situations such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews are present. The filing is purely administrative and discloses standard governance matters.
